assertions.text: Output contains a @TableTest annotation
assertions.evidence: @TableTest appears on addItemToCart, removeItemFromCart, applyCoupon, checkout, calculateTotal

assertions.text: Multiple @TableTest methods are used, each addressing a distinct concern
assertions.evidence: 5 separate methods: addItemToCart, removeItemFromCart, applyCoupon, checkout, calculateTotal

assertions.text: Each @TableTest has only rows needed for its concern—no unnecessary permutations
assertions.evidence: addItemToCart 3 rows, removeItemFromCart 3 rows, applyCoupon 5 rows, checkout 6, calculateTotal 7

assertions.text: Item, coupon, total, and checkout logic in separate @TableTest methods
assertions.evidence: addItemToCart/removeItemFromCart for items, applyCoupon for coupons, calculateTotal for totals, checkout

assertions.text: Each row independently executable; no row depends on prior row's result
assertions.evidence: All rows specify input state (Cart Before, Active Coupon, etc.) as columns, not relying on sequence

assertions.text: Coupon table uses before/after columns like 'Active coupon' / 'Active coupon after?'
assertions.evidence: applyCoupon table: 'Active Coupon' | ... | 'Applied Coupon?' shows before/after state change

assertions.text: Coupon table tests validity & replacement, not coupon type effects on price
assertions.evidence: applyCoupon tests 'Expired code', 'Nonexistent code', 'Replace'; calculateTotal tests PERCENT/FIXED/PRODUCT

assertions.text: Table has scenario/description column as leftmost column
assertions.evidence: 'Scenario' is first column in all 5 tables

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?'
assertions.evidence: 'Cart After?', 'Success?', 'Applied Coupon?', 'Message?', 'Total?' present across tables

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions, not outcomes
assertions.evidence: 'New item, empty cart', 'Remove the only item', 'Apply coupon when none active'

assertions.text: Column names use domain/business language, not code identifiers
assertions.evidence: 'Product', 'Qty', 'Cart', 'Coupon', 'Total', 'Message' used throughout; no 'productId' or 'result'

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: All @TableTest bodies: arrange-act-assert only; switch in parseCoupon is @TypeConverter, not test body

assertions.text: Annotations in order: @DisplayName, @Description, @TableTest
assertions.evidence: addItemToCart: @DisplayName, @Description, @TableTest; others follow subset order correctly

assertions.text: Test method has @DisplayName or clear descriptive method name
assertions.evidence: @DisplayName('Add item to cart') on addItemToCart; other method names clear (removeItemFromCart, applyCoupon)

assertions.text: If @Description present and multi-line, uses triple-quoted string, not +
assertions.evidence: All @Description use triple-quoted """ syntax

assertions.text: Each @TableTest has uniform assertion pattern applied to all rows
assertions.evidence: addItemToCart: same 3 assertions per row; calculateTotal: single assertion per row applied uniformly

assertions.text: Product prices and coupon rules visible in table/description/setup
assertions.evidence: CATALOGUE and COUPON_STORE defined at class level; applyCoupon description lists '...SAVE10 (10% off cart)...'

assertions.text: TypeConverter methods convert map/string values to domain objects; test bodies only arrange-act-assert
assertions.evidence: cartFrom(Map→Cart), inventoryFrom(Map→Inventory), @TypeConverter parseCoupon; bodies use only helpers

assertions.text: Coupon data in single column with @TypeConverter, not separate sparse columns
assertions.evidence: calculateTotal: single 'Coupon' column; @TypeConverter parseCoupon converts 'PERCENT:10', 'FIXED:5.00', etc.

assertions.text: Map columns use standard syntax [k: v, k2: v2] and [:], not custom notation
assertions.evidence: [WIDGET: 2], [WIDGET: 1, GADGET: 1], [:] used for carts and stock throughout

assertions.text: @Description does not repeat scenario info; coupon type behavior in scenario names, not description
assertions.evidence: calculateTotal scenarios name types ('Percentage off', 'Fixed amount', 'Product discount'); description explains rules/format
